import gzip, re, json
path='Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.cdna.all.fa.gz'
out=[]
with gzip.open(path,'rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('>'):
            parts=line[1:].strip().split()
            tid=parts[0]
            gene=ensg=symbol=None
            for p in parts[1:]:
                if p.startswith('gene:'): ensg=p[5:]
                if p.startswith('gene_symbol:'): symbol=p[12:]
            out.append((tid,ensg,symbol))
print(len(out), out[:3], out[-3:])
with open('transcript_gene.tsv','w') as f:
    f.write('transcript_id\\tgene_id\\tgene_symbol\\n')
    for tid,ensg,symbol in out:
        f.write(f'{tid}\\t{ensg or \"\"}\\t{symbol or \"\"}\\n')
PY
wc -l transcript_gene.tsv"

res <- merge(res, x[,c('"'gene_id','gene_symbol')], by='gene_id')

print(head(res, 30))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, binomtest, chi2_contingency
x=pd.read_csv('gene_counts.tsv',sep='\\t')
NA=x['countA'].sum(); NB=x['countB'].sum()
print(NA,NB)
# For each gene with max>=10, do Fisher exact table [A, NotA; B, NotB] and binomial test countB given total with p=NB/(NA+NB)
res=[]
for _,r in x.iterrows():
    a=int(r['countA']); b=int(r['countB'])
    if a+b<20: continue
    table=[[a, NA-a],[b, NB-b]]
    _,p=fisher_exact(table, alternative='two-sided')
    total=a+b; p_binom=binomtest(b,total,p=NB/(NA+NB),alternative='two-sided').pvalue
    lfc=np.log2((b+0.5)/(a+0.5))
    res.append((r['gene_symbol'],r['gene_id'],a,b,lfc,p,p_binom))
res=pd.DataFrame(res,columns=['symbol','gene_id','A','B','log2FC','fisher_p','binom_p'])
res=res.sort_values('fisher_p')
print(res.head(40).to_string(index=False))
RS"
